## Setup and usage questions

Use GitHub Discussions for installation/configuration questions, choosing a storage backend, optional
integration setup and general usage conversations.

## Bugs

Use the **Bug report** issue form and include the exact SodaEconomy, Paper/Purpur and Java versions,
storage backend/database version, installed integrations, reproducible steps and sanitized logs/config.

## Feature requests

Use the **Feature request** form. Describe the real use case, desired behaviour, alternatives and
affected subsystem. Large architectural proposals may be discussed before implementation.

## Security

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not disclose unresolved vulnerabilities in a public issue.

## Unsupported environments

Support is not currently claimed for Folia, Spigot/Bukkit-only servers, Paper/Purpur below the
documented minimum, or Java runtimes below the supported bytecode/runtime requirements. See the
[compatibility matrix](../docs/compatibility.md).

## Sensitive data

Never post database passwords, access tokens, private keys, full connection strings containing
credentials or other secrets. Redact them before attaching logs/configuration.
